**The checker no longer copies the live-locals set per branch.** `Live` in `crates/nvs-types/src/live.rs` is one set with an undo log; every `if`, loop, `case`, `try` arm, `catch` expression and closure marks it, rewinds it and joins back what every way out assigned. The ladder `benches/scaling/compiler/branches.nvs` is flat on the new binary (clock slope 1.02). The figures are in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What got better*. The constructor property check in `crates/nvs-types/src/ctor_init.rs` still copies its own set per branch; its new gap record is `data/gaps/nvs-types/the-constructor-init-state-is-cloned-per-branch.json`.

**15 gap records owned by `performance-pass`** keep `owners --closes performance-pass` red (`bun nv owners --closes performance-pass` lists them). `bun nv scaling --check` passed at the last sweep, with `numbers/bigint-mul` unclear. *Decisions for you* in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` has two entries: a total deadline for the request head, and `Markup` concatenation in place.
